title: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali
metaTitle: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali
metaDescription: Join our Yoga Alliance RYS 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. 25-day Hatha & Vinyasa Course with meditation, philosophy, sound healing & certification in paradise.
summary: The 200 Hour yoga teacher training at Bali Yoga School incorporates all the necessary areas of yoga, providing a balanced base in teaching and practice.
intro: 200 hour yoga teacher training in Ubud Bali is registered with Yoga Alliance. This 25 days course in Bali is for all the souls who want to pursue yoga from scratch with authentic methods, or who want to brush up their existing knowledge and skills and get certified as a yoga teacher.
It is not merely a course about learning the postures, but it is a course of self-discovery, discipline, philosophy, and learning how to guide others on their yoga path.

You will wake up just before sunrise, starting your day with yogic cleansing, practice Hatha vinyasa yoga to get some sweat out and center yourself physically and mentally. Have a nutritious vegan breakfast prepared freshly by our professional kitchen team, and continue your study of alignment & adjustment, teaching methodology, yoga anatomy, yoga philosophy. Fuel yourself up and get ready for the vigorous Ashtanga vinyasa yoga class. Have a healthy tea break, and the last class is meditation to relax your whole body and mind you have been using for a whole day!

Bali Yoga School is a Yoga Alliance Registered Yoga School for this program. After successfully completing the registered 200-hour training, graduates receive the school’s certificate and may apply separately to Yoga Alliance for the RYT 200 credential.

curriculum.title: Curriculum overview
curriculum.summary: The 200 Hour yoga teacher training at Bali Yoga School incorporates all the necessary areas of yoga, providing a balanced base in teaching and practice.
items: Asana Practice — Students learn various traditional styles such as Hatha, Ashtanga and Vinyasa yoga. Every pose is dissected with attention, with body alignment, advantages, variations, and safe teaching techniques.
Pranayama — The curriculum contains breathing exercises such as Anulom Vilom, Bhastrika, and Kapalabhati.
Meditation and Mindfulness — Guided visualizations, silent sitting, and all types of meditation are taught in daily meditation sessions.
Yoga Philosophy — Study of classical texts such as the Yoga Sutras and Bhagavad Gita.
Anatomy and Physiology — The response of the body to yoga practices, muscles, joints, and the nervous system.
Teaching Methodology — Practical teaching skills such as sequencing, clear instruction, and building inclusive environments.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 23rd of every month at 5:00 pm with farewell ceremony and 25th is last day and departure. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 4 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
prerequisites: A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. The practice and especially the teaching of yoga demand a high degree of self-discipline and purity.
To ensure the success of the program, participants are required to attend all spiritual activities, meditation sessions, lectures and asana classes.

Meat, fish, eggs, black tea, coffee, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the yoga practice. Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: All classes are mandatory. Only in case of an emergency or illness may a student take leave with permission from the respective teacher. Uninformed absences will not be accepted and may negatively affect the student's overall course performance.

policies.title: Discipline Rules for Students
items: Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited at Bali Yoga School. If you are fasting on any day, please inform the kitchen manager in advance to help avoid food waste.

Students are expected to maintain discipline, respect teachers and follow all school rules. Please arrive on time for every scheduled class. Students who arrive late may not be permitted to join the class.
All outstanding accounts must be cleared before departure. Students must also return any books, maps or other items borrowed from Bali Yoga School before leaving.

Bali Yoga School provides accommodation for students enrolled in the yoga course. Friends or relatives are not included in the student's accommodation; however, additional accommodation may be arranged separately, subject to room availability and applicable charges.
Students are required to participate in all scheduled programs and activities included in the 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali.

faqs.q: What is a 200-hour yoga teacher training?
faqs.a: A 200-hour yoga teacher training is a foundational professional yoga training program designed to develop your personal practice while introducing the knowledge and skills required to teach yoga. At Bali Yoga School, the training covers practical yoga practice together with subjects such as asana, pranayama, meditation, yoga philosophy, anatomy, alignment, adjustments and teaching methodology. Successful graduates receive a 200-hour Yoga Alliance accredited certificate.
